$comment: How long a connection state the person can do nothing about (reconnecting, retrying, handshaking, restoring, "Getting access", offline, disconnected) stays out of sight before one calm line says it. Leo, 2026-11-14: "i also want all our connectivity stuff to shut the fuck up and load faster/percievably load faster / whatever it takes / desktop gui, ios, remote, cloud, etc"; on LTE, 2026-11-12: "wack reconnection state / just show the cache". 10 s: a phone network blip, an app foreground reattach and a daemon handoff after an update (about 10 s, #27541) all heal under it, and an open view that is still down past it has been down long enough to matter. A state the person can act on (one button that fixes it) may show at once. Copies, each checked against this value by scripts/cmux-next/check-connection-notices.py: CONNECTION_QUIET_MS (webviews/src/ui/lasting.ts), NoticeTiming.connectionQuiet (CmuxNextDesignTokens/NoticeTiming.swift), QuietStatusGate.threshold (cmux-next-ios CmuxMobileDesign/QuietStatusGate.swift).
